sourcePartsHint: Two RTL-SDRs by burned-in serial (1000/1001). The real CRRS Site 003 P25 channels are just five: 856.0875/856.5375/857.0875(control)/857.5375/859.5375, spanning only 3.45 MHz, so two 2.4 MHz dongles cover them all. 1000@856.8 holds the control channel + three voice; 1001@858.7 holds 859.5375. (The original 853.0 center was a mistake -- that band is the LEGACY Motorola system, a different system.)

systems.systemNameHint: Capital Region Radio System (Richmond/Henrico/Chesterfield), P25 Phase II simulcast, Site 003. Control channel 857.0875 confirmed live. POLICE ENCRYPTED (auto-skipped); FIRE/EMS in the clear -- the target. NOTE: locks + decodes system identity fine, but per-call grant (TSBK) decode is not working -- this is a SIMULCAST decode-quality limit on RTL-SDRs, not a config error (verified: correct channels, encryption shown, newer image -- all still zero grants).
